title: Text Processing & Sampling
summary: This module handles the core logic for text tokenization, detokenization, grammar enforcement, and various token sampling strategies within the LLM runtime. It ensures generated text adheres to rules and exhibits desired properties like diversity or coherence.

nodes.label: Detokenize Text
nodes.title: common_detokenize
nodes.description: Converts a sequence of numerical tokens back into a human-readable string using the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Sample & Accept Draft Tokens
nodes.title: common_sampler_sample_and_accept_n
nodes.description: Samples and accepts a specified number of tokens from a draft sequence, often used in speculative decoding.

nodes.label: Map Sampler Types
nodes.title: common_sampler_types_from_chars
nodes.description: Converts character representations of sampling strategies (e.g., 'k' for Top-K) into their corresponding internal sampler types.

nodes.label: Apply Grammar Rules
nodes.title: llama_grammar_apply_impl
nodes.description: Filters token candidates based on active grammar rules, ensuring generated text conforms to a specified structure.

nodes.label: Accept String into Grammar
nodes.title: llama_grammar_accept_str
nodes.description: Processes a string piece, updating the grammar state to reflect the accepted characters.

nodes.label: Accept Token into Grammar
nodes.title: llama_grammar_accept_token
nodes.description: Processes a token and its string representation, updating the grammar state based on the accepted token.

nodes.label: Parse Grammar Character
nodes.title: parse_char
nodes.description: Parses a single character or escape sequence from a grammar definition string.

nodes.label: Print Grammar Rule
nodes.title: print_rule
nodes.description: Formats and prints a grammar rule to a file, useful for debugging or visualization.

nodes.label: Implement Grammar Acceptance
nodes.title: llama_grammar_accept_impl
nodes.description: Core logic for accepting tokens into the grammar, including handling trigger patterns and end-of-grammar conditions.

nodes.label: Apply Mirostat Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_mirostat_apply
nodes.description: Adjusts token probabilities using the Mirostat algorithm to control perplexity and diversity.

nodes.label: Apply Extended Temperature Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_temp_ext_apply
nodes.description: Dynamically adjusts temperature based on the entropy of token probabilities to control generation randomness.

nodes.label: Apply Mirostat V2 Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_mirostat_v2_apply
nodes.description: Applies the Mirostat V2 algorithm for dynamic token probability adjustment, focusing on surprise and learning rate.

nodes.label: Apply Top-K Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_top_k_apply
nodes.description: Selects the next token from the K most probable tokens, discarding less likely options.

nodes.label: Apply Top-P Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_top_p_apply
nodes.description: Selects the next token from the smallest set of most probable tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds P.

nodes.label: Apply Typical P Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_typical_apply
nodes.description: Filters tokens based on their 'typicality' relative to the distribution's entropy, promoting more coherent text.

nodes.label: Apply XTC Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sample_xtc_apply
nodes.description: Implements eXtreme Truncation Control sampling, potentially truncating the candidate list based on probability thresholds.

nodes.label: Apply Top-N Sigma Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_top_n_sigma_apply
nodes.description: Filters tokens based on their logit distance from the mean, using a multiple of the standard deviation.

nodes.label: Apply Infill Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_infill_apply
nodes.description: Adjusts token probabilities specifically for infill scenarios, handling end-of-grammar tokens and token merging.

nodes.label: Perform Token Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_sample
nodes.description: Orchestrates the overall token sampling process, applying various configured sampling strategies to logits.

nodes.label: Apply Min-P Sampling
nodes.title: llama_sampler_min_p_apply
nodes.description: Filters tokens, keeping only those whose probability is at least a minimum fraction (P) of the most probable token.

nodes.label: Reset Sampler Chain
nodes.title: llama_sampler_chain_reset
nodes.description: Resets the state of all samplers within a sampling chain, preparing for a new generation sequence.

nodes.label: Initialize UGM Tokenizer
nodes.title: llm_tokenizer_ugm
nodes.description: Sets up a tokenizer specifically for Unigram Model (UGM) vocabularies, including prefix replacements and score tracking.

nodes.label: Initialize BPE Tokenizer
nodes.title: llm_tokenizer_bpe
nodes.description: Configures a Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizer with predefined regex patterns for various model types.

nodes.label: Initialize RWKV Tokenizer
nodes.title: llm_tokenizer_rwkv
nodes.description: Initializes a tokenizer for RWKV models, building a trie for efficient token matching from the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get Vocabulary Size
nodes.title: llama_n_vocab
nodes.description: Returns the total number of tokens available in the loaded vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get Token Score
nodes.title: llama_token_get_score
nodes.description: Retrieves the score associated with a specific token from the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get Token Attributes
nodes.title: llama_token_get_attr
nodes.description: Fetches special attributes (e.g., normal, control, user-defined) for a given token.

nodes.label: Check End-Of-Grammar Token
nodes.title: llama_token_is_eog
nodes.description: Determines if a given token is designated as an End-Of-Grammar token.

nodes.label: Check Control Token
nodes.title: llama_token_is_control
nodes.description: Determines if a given token is a control token, used for special model instructions.

nodes.label: Get BOS Token
nodes.title: llama_token_bos
nodes.description: Returns the Beginning-Of-Sentence token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get EOS Token
nodes.title: llama_token_eos
nodes.description: Returns the End-Of-Sentence token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get EOT Token
nodes.title: llama_token_eot
nodes.description: Returns the End-Of-Text token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get CLS Token
nodes.title: llama_token_cls
nodes.description: Returns the Classification token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get SEP Token
nodes.title: llama_token_sep
nodes.description: Returns the Separator token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get Newline Token
nodes.title: llama_token_nl
nodes.description: Returns the Newline token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Get Padding Token
nodes.title: llama_token_pad
nodes.description: Returns the Padding token ID for the vocabulary.

nodes.label: Check Add BOS Token
nodes.title: llama_add_bos_token
nodes.description: Indicates whether a Beginning-Of-Sentence token should be automatically added.

nodes.label: Check Add EOS Token
nodes.title: llama_add_eos_token
nodes.description: Indicates whether an End-Of-Sentence token should be automatically added.

nodes.label: Get FIM Prefix Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_pre
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) prefix token ID.

nodes.label: Get FIM Suffix Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_suf
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) suffix token ID.

nodes.label: Get FIM Middle Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_mid
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) middle token ID.

nodes.label: Get FIM Padding Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_pad
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) padding token ID.

nodes.label: Get FIM Replacement Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_rep
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) replacement token ID.

nodes.label: Get FIM Separator Token
nodes.title: llama_token_fim_sep
nodes.description: Returns the Fill-in-the-Middle (FIM) separator token ID.

nodes.label: Split Text by Regex
nodes.title: unicode_regex_split
nodes.description: Splits a given text string into segments using Unicode-aware regular expressions, handling various character categories.

nodes.label: Get Unicode Codepoint Flags
nodes.title: unicode_cpt_flags_from_utf8
nodes.description: Extracts and returns flags (e.g., letter, number, punctuation) for a Unicode codepoint from its UTF-8 representation.

nodes.label: Convert UTF-8 to Byte
nodes.title: unicode_utf8_to_byte
nodes.description: Converts a UTF-8 string representation of a single byte into its numerical byte value.
